english: The line over a bot's head (hunting, off to the blacksmith, fishing). Switch it off for players who mind it. The shout on the world chat about a +7/+8/+9 upgrade stays either way.
Skill books without the day's wait

The game makes a character wait about a day between two reads of the same skill, so a bot needs a month to read a skill from M1 to G1, and the books pile up in its bag meanwhile. On: a bot reads a book the moment it has one - the game itself is the only brake. Off: the game's daily wait, unchanged.

The share of stall keepers that put their weak upgrades (+0 to +3) on the counter for pennies instead of selling them to an NPC - scrap for burning at the blacksmith, as on hard servers. Off by default.
The share of bots that stay by the stalls for a while after an errand in town instead of going straight back to hunting. At 100 percent the town is lively, at 0 everyone is out in the field.
Moonlight Chest - from a killed monster

How often a chest drops: from a killed monster and from a broken Metin. The game default is 1 and 30 percent; more chests mean more bonus scrolls, speed potions and Blessing Scrolls for the bots. Applies within five seconds, to bots and players alike.
